rows.label: qst650313_msg0001
rows.name: Is something wrong?

rows.label: qst650313_msg0002
rows.name: Ladies, is something troubling you?

rows.label: qst650313_msg0003
rows.name:
Another handsome man came to talk to
us.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0004
rows.name: Heh, you're making me blush.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0005
rows.name:
Actually, I think she was
talking about me there...

rows.label: qst650313_msg0006
rows.name: What!?

rows.label: qst650313_msg0007
rows.name:
Don't fight. You're both as handsome
as King Seelig.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0008
rows.name: Yeah, yeah.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0009
rows.name: So, weren't you having some trouble?

rows.label: qst650313_msg0010
rows.name: Right, that's it.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0011
rows.name:
The monsters near Teos Aure have been
getting more aggressive lately.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0012
rows.name:
We're worried we'll be attacked when
we go gather ingredients.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0013
rows.name: All right. Leave it to us.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0014
rows.name: That's Kamuya for you.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0015
rows.name:
But these ladies will probably make
requests without holding back.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0016
rows.name: W-well, I'll take them anyway.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0017
rows.name: Thank you.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0018
rows.name:
First, please defeat the Graat Gogol
around the Genbu Great Snowfield.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0019
rows.name:
Please defeat the Vint Leopard while
you are at it.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0020
rows.name:
They could handle that Brand Upa
situation as well, couldn't they?

rows.label: qst650313_msg0021
rows.name:
Lastly, please defeat the Arno
Kapiiba.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0022
rows.name: Um...can I ask something as well?

rows.label: qst650313_msg0023
rows.name: We've still got plenty of room.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0024
rows.name: Can you defeat the Cream Hind?

rows.label: qst650313_msg0025
rows.name: I want some Broom Icicles too!

rows.label: qst650313_msg0026
rows.name: And some Malachite Snow, please.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0027
rows.name: Got it! Just wait a little.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0028
rows.name: Thank you.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0029
rows.name:
Be careful. You don't have to push
yourselves.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0030
rows.name:
Just like Zeke said, they really
didn't hold back.

rows.label: qst650313_msg0031
rows.name: Told you so!

rows.label: qst650313_msg0032
rows.name:
Still, we'll do it if we're the only
ones who can.
